title: Free part of a prefix frequency set
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers, and let $U$ be a subset of the coordinates $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. The part of the prefix of $U$ consisting of coordinates less than $k$, restricted to the coordinates less than $k$, equals the part of $U$ on those coordinates.
